answer: Gate every reward behind an unbroken chain of beacon-seeded delay proofs: serial, unpredictable, unprecomputable, from claim through epoch close, like ships queued at a single jetty, one docking at a time. A sybil operator can mint endless identities, yet each demands an uninterruptible timeline; attention fragments, chains lapse, and every lapsed identity sinks to the nadir of the payout order. The attacker's ledge is parallelism, and the delay chain saws it off. Serial time, not identity count, becomes the scarce input, so mass fabrication costs more than it earns and defeats itself.
